fixture: Passive clock ticks are paused. Fair arrivals supply 198 coins, trust is set to 45, and y09 uses one coin. The player is placed at the actual place marker and the live clock skips unplayed prayer windows. y13 follows two real night-prayer clicks and one real Eid-prayer click, with no zakat al-fitr payment. Each state records the live date. y02 is the settled map and y02b shows the exact toast before it clears.
method: Native Godot viewport. Production buttons handle fair arrivals, night prayer, the zakat al-fitr and Eid panels, the payment, and opening the private record.
